title: Exposure Draft on IRDAI(Relaxations under Appointed Actuary Regulations 2017 and appointment of Mentors) Guidelines, 2017
full_text:
**EXPOSURE DRAFT on** Ref: IRDA/ACTL/REGN/2016-17 on
You are requested to offer your comments/ suggestions on the proposed guidelines for consideration of the same by the Authority. The comments/ suggestions in MSWORD format(Annexure-1) should be sent by e-mail to pankajk.tewari@irda.gov.in with a copy to shyama@irda.gov.in latest by 28th February, 2017. .. S.P. Chakraborty GM (Actuarial)
